name: Sanctions & coercion
value: EU 22nd package due before end of Nov
summary: The EU is to present a 22nd Russia sanctions package before the end of November, after listing nearly 50 more banks
state: Commission President von der Leyen said on 18 Nov that the 22nd sanctions package against Russia will be presented the following week (Interfax-Ukraine). Consultations began on 17 Nov and the package is expected to target banking, crypto channels and the shadow fleet, with no headline measures expected (Euronews). The EU listed nearly 50 more Russian banks on 16 Nov, and visa curbs are under discussion after Denmark's 20 Nov plot allegations. No major economy has been cut off from payment systems, so Watch holds.
for_you: Firms trading with Russia or using shipping linked to it face tighter compliance checks. UK and EU businesses can check OFSI and EU sanctions guidance for current listings.
rubric_hit: Watch: major new package in preparation (EU 22nd) after 16 Nov bank listings; no payment-system cut-off
